new_contract_line: | BR-0051 | `qfai init --force` prunes QFAI-generated command and prompt wrappers and non-symlink generated `qfai-*` skill wrapper directories. It does not delete unrelated adopter-owned content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | EX-0001-0027-01                                   |

| BR-0057 | `qfai init --upgrade-assistant-tree` is idempotent on a project already using `rule/`, `skill/`, `agent/` and `prompt/`: it leaves those files unchanged, exits 0 and reports preserved user edits rather than failing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | EX-0001-0035-03                                   |

| BR-0059 | After the announced v1.10.0 sunset, an ordinary init keeps legacy `.qfai/assistant/steering/` files unchanged and reports `D-DEPRECATED-PATH` as an error on stderr. The finding names the sunset and `qfai init --upgrade-assistant-tree` without claiming read compatibility.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | EX-0001-0037-01, EX-0001-0037-02                  |

| BR-0064 | Every pinned action has a readable version in its step `name:` without a leading `v`. No version-bearing pin trailer is placed in shipped comments; shipped text satisfies the unchanged version-leakage guard.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | EX-0002-0002-04                  |

| BR-0099 | `qfai validate` is the machine gate for deterministic schema, evidence and canonical validator checks. It aggregates their findings in the validate result.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | EX-0001-0039-01                                                                                      |

| BR-0100 | Canonical UIX validation checks prototyping evidence against every screen ID declared by its UI contract and reports missing screen evidence against the corresponding screen.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | EX-0001-0041-01                                                                                      |

| BR-0127 | `qfai prototyping certify` reads `validate-prototyping.json` for its profile gate; a newer default-profile `validate.json` pointer is not a prototyping pass. Certify does not silently rerun validate. At or after the announced 1.10.0 sunset, legacy `.qfai/output/validate.json` is not written and `D-DEPRECATED-PATH` is an error.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | EX-0001-0049-03, EX-0001-0049-04                                   |

| BR-0212 | Test volume counts and ratios guide planning only. ATDD completion requires test coverage for every in-scope BF and AC, regardless of volume signal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | EX-0001-0069-03                  |

| BR-0213 | ATDD implementation and approval are separate: a non-edit Reviewer, distinct from the test implementer, returns PASS or REVISE and names a missing BF E2E test in a REVISE finding.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | EX-0001-0073-03                  |

| BR-0225 | `/qfai-configure` adds exclude globs only when an observed test path needs exclusion beyond the default exclusions; it does not add redundant exclude patterns.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | EX-0001-0078-04                  |
